# Configuration reference

This reference is generated from [`schemas/config.v1.schema.json`](../schemas/config.v1.schema.json), which is authoritative. Regenerate it with `go run ./hack/gen-config-reference.go`. Veduta loads `veduta.yaml` and then merges sibling `conf.d/*.yaml` files in lexical order; later values replace earlier values and arrays replace as a whole.

Unknown fields are rejected. A required field can still be conditional on a selected mode or runtime; the schema and `veduta --check-config` enforce those conditions. Paths containing `<name>` are maps keyed by an operator-chosen ID, and `[]` denotes an array item.

| `auth` | object | yes | — | 3 conditional rule(s) | Required. There is no implicit default: a dashboard that holds service credentials must state, in the file, who may reach it. With mode: none the server refuses to bind anything but loopback unless --i-know-what-im-doing is passed. |

| `dashboard.appearance` | "clean" | no | "clean" | — | Visual preset for this instance. A preset owns its own surface opacity, scrim, border, shadow and blur; those are deliberately not configurable. Only 'clean' is implemented today - the enum widens as presets ship, which is backward-compatible, whereas admitting a value before its preset exists would accept configuration that silently does nothing. This is NOT the light/dark axis: that is a per-viewer browser preference and is not configured here. |
